repos_data.description: The Everything is Real-Time C# Backend for Single Page Applications
The rails-like Go framework you didn't know you needed
The unified web layer for AI agents. Search (8 engines), stealth browse, auth, and act on 24 platforms. One npm install, self-hosted.
🤖 A client-first, server-capable, fully type-safe router and full-stack framework for the web (React and more).

repo_meta_data.description: The batteries-included full-stack framework for the AI era. Develop JS/TS web apps (React, Node.js, and Prisma) using declarative code that abstracts away complex full-stack features like auth, background jobs, RPC, email sending, end-to-end type safety, single-command deployment, and more.
